text:
I'm ●.
Yes, a pleasing sound.
It suits your countenance.
Thank you.
You find it strange, don't you?
That I lead the settlement
though I am not its Guardian.
Well, yes...
By rights, as Guardian,
that man should
be the one to rule.
But he refused,
to uphold his
long-standing loyalty to me...
Loyalty?
Let us speak
of that another day.
Come to me whenever you have
trouble. If it is within my power,
I shall help you.
Thank you,
Lady Misumi.
This is the settlement
where everyone from
Silturn lives.
The village is called
the Land of Wind and Thunder!
The Land of Wind and Thunder...
A village of people from Silturn...
I once visited
the Silturn autonomous district
when I was a student, but...
The atmosphere is completely different.
It's much calmer
and more rustic here.
The atmosphere is different.
It's much calmer
and more rustic here...
There's someone important
in this settlement
called Miss Princess.
With her as their leader,
everyone lives
in harmony!
They grow vegetables in the fields
and hunt in the forest.
Yes, it looks that way.
There's a rice paddy over there.
It looks that way.
Is that a rice paddy
I can see over there?
Cooked rice
is delicious!
Sometimes Marurur
gets invited to eat too!
Oh...
The Guardian here
is Mr. Ninja.
You just met him,
so there's no need
to visit again.
Mr. Ninja
is at the manor.
His job is
to protect Miss Princess
and Little Rascal.
Little Rascal?
Oh, you mean
Subaru.
Oh, you mean
Subaru.
He's always
teasing Marurur!
You should
be careful too, Teacher!
O-okay...?
O-oh...?
WELCOME...
YOU ARE MOST WELCOME...
No, I'm the one
